title: Railway RRB Technician Online Form 2026 (6557 Posts)
vacancyDetails: Technician Grade-I Signal ~323 + Technician Grade-III ~6234 = 6557 posts across zones
qualification: Matriculation / ITI / Diploma / Degree as per trade and Grade (Signal vs Grade-III categories in CEN)
ageLimit: 18 to 33/36 years as per CEN 02/2026 (relaxations applicable)
applicationFee: As per RRB fee (₹500/₹250 with refund rules for eligible categories)
selectionProcess: Computer Based Test (CBT) → Document Verification → Medical Examination
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.rrbapply.gov.in
2. Open CEN 02/2026 Technician Apply Online
3. Create account and fill preferences
4. Upload photo/sign/documents and pay fee
5. Submit by 29 July 2026 (11:59 PM)
shortDescription: RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Online Form for 6557 posts. Apply 30 June – 29 July 2026 at rrbapply.gov.in.
content:
Railway Recruitment Boards have released CEN 02/2026 for 6,557 Technician posts (Grade-I Signal and Grade-III).

Online applications: 30 June 2026 to 29 July 2026. Selection mainly through single-stage CBT followed by DV and medical.

Official apply portal: rrbapply.gov.in.
